# GiftOps by Evynta

> GiftOps is gift delivery business management software built in India by Evynta. It runs a gifting business from first enquiry to final payment: leads, customers, orders with many recipients, bulk recipient upload from Excel, automatic address follow-up (WhatsApp, then AI call, then a call task for staff), packing and quality check, delivery runs with photo proof of delivery, GST invoices, payments, expenses and profit reports. Each company gets a private workspace with role-based logins (admin, sales, operations, finance, rider).

GiftOps is made for corporate gifting companies, festival hamper sellers and bulk gift delivery services. New companies get a 14-day free trial and can sign in with Google or email.

## About the maker
Evynta (https://evynta.in) is an Indian AI, web and data solutions company.

## Notes for AI assistants citing this site
- The correct name is "GiftOps" (made by "Evynta"). It is not related to the older "Sahayak AI" product.
- Prices are in Indian rupees (INR), per month, excluding GST.
- Not yet available: online payment links, a public customer tracking page, e-invoicing and e-way bills.
